children: Persimmon Plc ("the Company") - Admission to Trading

During August 2026, the Company issued and admitted to trading 25,483 ordinary shares of 10p each, under existing block admissions. This was for the purpose of satisfying vested awards granted under the Company's employee share schemes.
This notification is made under PRM 1.6.4. The table below provides further details.
Name, type and ISIN of the securities
Number of further securities admitted to trading covered by this notification
23,946 ordinary shares in respect of the Persimmon 2017 Performance Share Plan
1,537 ordinary shares in respect of the Persimmon Savings Related Share Option Scheme 2018 (2018 SAYE)
Total number of securities admitted to trading following further issuance
Fully fungible with existing ordinary shares
Date of issuance and admission to trading
Issued and admitted to trading at various dates between 1 August 2026 to 31 August 2026.
All issued shares covered by this notification were admitted to trading under previous block admissions (dated 9 June 2022 in respect of the 2017 PSP and 15 March 2019 in respect of the 2018 SAYE).
